sources.title: specklabs/Speck1-140M-Instruct · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Speck1-140M-Instruct is a 140.7M parameter English instruction-tuned language model. It was initialized from Speck1-140M, a hybrid model that interleaves global grouped-query attention with gated causal convolution, then fully fine-tuned for one epoch on SpeckChat1.

sources.title: GitHub - IBM/gguf: IBM GGUF-encoded AI models and conversion scripts
sources.snippet: This repository provides an automated CI/CD process to convert, test and deploy IBM Granite models, in safetensor format, from the ibm-granite organization to IBM GGUF versions (with various supported quantizations) within model repositories respectively named with the -GGUF extension. These GGUF model repositories are also included to the Granite Quantized Model collection for convenience.

sources.snippet: A privacy-first, beginner-friendly desktop application for running large language models fully locally on Windows, Linux, and macOS. Load any GGUF model (Mistral, LLaMA, DeepSeek, Qwen, and thousands more from Hugging Face) and chat with it — with a built-in agentic mode that can read, create, edit, and organize files in a workspace you choose.
